spans.s:
uñchavṛtti
(‘living by leftover grains’)
------------------------------------------
Some of the ब्राह्मणस्, in the olden days, who wanted to live a very austere life, adopted उञ्छवृत्ति for a living, since it entailed no violence or harm to other living beings.
It consisted in gathering grains from agricultural fields after the harvesting was over. Collecting the grains that have fallen on the ground in any shop that sells grains was also included under उञ्छवृत्ति. ड़ोओद् cooked out of these grains was considered very pure.
Vedānta Deśika (A.
-1847) are said to have lived by this means.
